stepTypeDescriptions.Agent: An AI agent does one job, like writing the narration or picking clips
stepTypeDescriptions.Conditional: Go one way or another depending on an earlier result
stepTypeDescriptions.ForEach: Repeat a step for each item in a list
stepTypeDescriptions.ReviewLoop: Check the result and redo earlier steps until it is good enough
stepTypeDescriptions.Parallel: Run several agents at the same time and combine their work
stepTypeDescriptions.Extract: Trim earlier results down to what the next AI step needs
stepTypeDescriptions.VideoAnalyze: Watch your footage: find shots, pauses and what is said
stepTypeDescriptions.VideoCompile: Put the final video together from the chosen clips
stepTypeDescriptions.VideoGenerate: Generate new video clips from a description (paid, with a spending limit)
stepTypeDescriptions.Voiceover: Read narration aloud with an AI voice
stepTypeDescriptions.EditRoom: A team of AI editors discusses the footage and agrees on one cut
stepTypeDescriptions.GraphicsRoom: A team of AI designers agrees on titles and graphics
stepTypeDescriptions.ColorGradeRoom: A team of AI colourists agrees on one colour look
stepTypeDescriptions.ThumbnailGenerate: Pick the best frame from your footage and save it as an image
stepTypeDescriptions.Revise: Makes the changes you asked for to a finished video and renders it again.
stepTypeDescriptions.DesignGraphic: Designs one graphic for a picture, such as a title, badge or price tag.
stepTypeDescriptions.DailiesRoom: A team of AI judges compares the generated takes of each shot and picks the best one
stepTypeDescriptions.TimelineRender: Turn a timeline from the editor into a finished video file
stepTypeDescriptions.DesignSystem: Reads your design files and app structure into a brand and product profile the later steps use (free)
stepTypeDescriptions.ExtractFrame: Save one frame of a video as an image, to reuse as a picture, a cover or the first frame of a new clip (free)
stepTypeDescriptions.AudioGenerate: Generate music or a sound effect from a description (paid, with a spending limit)
stepTypeDescriptions.ImageGenerate: Make pictures from a description, or change one picture by an instruction (paid, with a spending limit)
stepTypeDescriptions.PinInsert: Put a video or image on the tracked screens of your footage, without an AI model (free)
stepTypeDescriptions.VideoEnhance: Sharpen the picture: make it bigger, smoother, cleaner or less choppy

agentDescriptions.CodeStructureAnalyzer: Learns your app's screens and how they fit together.
agentDescriptions.DependencyAnalyzer: Spots the frameworks and libraries your app is built with.
agentDescriptions.ComponentInventoryAnalyzer: Lists the buttons, cards and views worth showing off.
agentDescriptions.RouteAndApiAnalyzer: Maps the pages and journeys a viewer can follow.
agentDescriptions.StyleAndThemeExtractor: Picks up your colours, fonts and visual style.
agentDescriptions.RemotionComponentTranslator: Rebuilds your screens as animated video scenes.
agentDescriptions.AnimationStrategyAgent: Plans how each scene moves and transitions.
agentDescriptions.DirectorAgent: Decides the shot order, pacing and story beats.
agentDescriptions.ScriptwriterAgent: Writes the story and the words on screen.
agentDescriptions.AuthorAgent: Assembles the scenes and renders the finished video.
agentDescriptions.ReviewAgent: Checks the result and asks for fixes when needed.
agentDescriptions.FileSummarizerAgent: Writes a short summary of each file you upload.
agentDescriptions.ExtractTransform: Trims earlier results down to what the next step needs.
agentDescriptions.VideoStoryEditor: Chooses the best moments from your footage.
agentDescriptions.VideoTransform: Handles your footage: watching it, cutting it and exporting the video.
agentDescriptions.VideoReviewAgent: Watches the cut and asks for fixes when needed.
agentDescriptions.MusicSupervisor: Picks a music track and how loud it plays.
agentDescriptions.VideoEditDirector: Leads the editing discussion and makes the final cut.
agentDescriptions.MotionGraphicsDirector: Leads the graphics discussion and signs off the design.
agentDescriptions.Colorist: Chooses the colour look of your video.
agentDescriptions.ColorGradeDirector: Leads the colour discussion and picks the final look.
agentDescriptions.SoundDesigner: Adds whooshes, clicks and other sound effects.
agentDescriptions.Assistant: Answers questions and helps you set things up.
agentDescriptions.ShotDirector: Plans extra generated shots such as b-roll and end cards.
agentDescriptions.NarrationWriter: Writes the voiceover script for your video.
agentDescriptions.PickupPlanner: Plans re-recorded lines to fix flubs in your dialogue.
agentDescriptions.NarrationTranslator: Translates the narration into another language.
agentDescriptions.CompositionReviser: Makes the changes you ask for to a finished video.
agentDescriptions.GraphicDesigner: Designs a single graphic for a picture — a title, badge, price tag or shape — with a transparent background.
agentDescriptions.TakeSelector: Compares the AI-generated takes of each shot and says which reads best.
agentDescriptions.DailiesDirector: Leads the take review and writes down which take to keep for each shot.

compute.routingNote: We use your paired machines for media work when they're online; everything else runs on ReelBolt.
compute.scopeNote: Choose where your media work, such as video renders, compiles and analysis, runs.

Auto.label: Automatic (the default)
Auto.description: Use a paired machine when one is online; otherwise ReelBolt runs it.

PreferRunner.label: Prefer my machines
PreferRunner.description: Uses a paired machine when one is online; otherwise ReelBolt runs it.

RunnerOnly.label: Only my machines
RunnerOnly.description: Runs only on your paired machines; if none is online the step stops with a clear message.
RunnerOnly.warning: Video renders need a machine that reported a container runtime. A machine without one cannot take them, so a render fails here rather than running anywhere else. This is the only choice that turns an offline machine into a failed run instead of a queued one.

compute.tipServer: The server that handled this run did this step itself. No paired machine and no cloud worker was involved.
compute.tipChip: At least one step of this run ran on a machine paired to this workspace. Open the run to see which step, and where the rest of them ran.
